recommendations.summary: the desk's own briefing presents a validation probe as if it were the plan
recommendations.guidance: rcm-reducer-probe is a reducer-validation fixture; a briefing that shows it beside the production plan invites a lead to read the wrong graph

proposal.body: ASSEMBLE "desk_pulse" FROM plan: (RECALL workflows WHERE name = "rcm-denial-optimization" LIMIT 1), tools: (RECALL tools WHERE kind = "definition" LIMIT 12), activity: (RECALL tools WHERE kind != "definition" RECENT 10), lessons: (RECALL facts WHERE namespace = "org.rcm.*" LIMIT 40) BUDGET 2500 tokens FORMAT markdown
